subject: BaseTools: GenFfs/GenFv/GenSec: Fixing Warning 4319 from MSVC
reasons: Three instances across GenFfs/GenFv/GenSec but each has a different fix: one adds (UINT32) cast to sizeof, another adds (UINTN) cast to the mask expression - not a uniform single pattern
The fixes are in C files under BaseTools (not edk2 firmware C), and the specific operand being cast differs per site
Low repetitiveness within firmware sources; the pattern is compiler-warning-specific and the cast target differs between instances
